maturity: SPECIFIED (this file) -> IMPLEMENTED (scripts/dev/motor/feasibility02) -> EXECUTED (records) -> DEMONSTRATED only for what the refinement and cross-checks establish; no 3D, thermal, manufacturing or customer claim

limits.holding: mean >= 6.0 N m, pk-pk <= 0.30 N m and <= 5 % of |mean| at the precision command
limits.peak: mean >= 12 N m, pk-pk <= 0.60 N m and <= 5 % of |mean| at the peak command (reported; not part of the Test Lead's feasibility question)

topologies.8p24s: registered single-layer control (existing 246 public points and 30 zero-current solves are its evidence)
topologies.10p12s: double-layer tooth winding from the star of slots; fundamental winding factor 0.933 checked; current offset alpha0 = +15 electrical (registered deck: -120 for 8p24s), verified by a current-angle check

design_space.fixed: registered frame: 92 mm stator OD, 25.6 mm rotor radius, 35 mm stack, Br 1.2 T, generic Brauer iron, tip 0.6 mm, wedge 0.34 mm
design_space.validity: slot >= 1 mm per layer where the coil starts, opening clearance 0.2 mm, slot depth >= 1 mm, yoke >= 1 mm (geometric only)
design_space.skew: three equal slices, offsets -s/2, 0, +s/2 mechanical, s in {0, 2, 4} degrees; slice k = 2D solve at rotor angle theta + d_k with current angle gamma - 5 d_k (same phase currents); each slice is full-stack-equivalent and the stack curve is their mean (1/3 each, once); ripple from the combined curve
design_space.not_run: second-tier magnet-edge chamfer and tooth-tip notch (no frozen CAD grammar yet); 3D end and skew-edge effects

commands.panel: unpowered J 0; holding J {8, 10} x gamma {0, 15}; acceleration J {12, 15} x gamma {0, 15} (J in A/mm^2 over each coil region, the registered deck's convention)
commands.selection_frozen: precision command J 10, gamma 0; peak command J 15, gamma 0; all other commands are diagnostics

sampling.window: one loaded period, 360/(6p): 12 degrees for 10p12s, plus its end point for the periodicity check

stages.S1: 24 public 10p12s designs (topology.draw('MOTOR-FEAS02-10p12s', 24)) x {J0, J8g0, J8g15, J10g0, J10g15}, unskewed: 120 solves. Zero-current skew is exact from the J0 curve (pure shifts).
stages.S2: designs with best-span skewed cogging <= 0.10 N m and an unskewed holding mean >= 5.4 N m: skew variants gamma - 5 d for d in {-2, -1, +1, +2} for every holding command (16 solves per design)
stages.S3: designs whose skewed holding curve at some span is within margin (mean >= 5.9, pk-pk <= 0.32, fraction <= 0.055, cogging <= 0.07): refinement rungs on the precision command and J0 at the passing span, plus peak commands with skew at standard
stages.resolution: packet section 5: successive rungs change mean by <= 0.10 N m and pk-pk by <= 0.02 N m; zero-current Maxwell stress vs virtual work (co-energy) within those bounds; a value whose rung change straddles a limit is UNRESOLVED

near_misses: kept and reported: every design within 2x of any limit
periodicity: torque one window on repeats within 1e-3 of max |torque| or 1e-3 N m absolute (near-zero curves)
end_effects: 2D only: any feasible result is a 2D magnetic shortlist; end leakage, skew-edge and axial effects are UNRESOLVED until 3D witnesses
